name: Tide
rules:
Clear, confident and clean: a product explaining itself.

- Blue #1F5FBF is the brand: bands, primary buttons, solid badges. The third mode ("green" in vibe.json) is the blue band.
- Yellow #FFC53D is the accent and gets ONE hit per shot: an underline, a highlight, a key number. Text on yellow is black, never white.
- The glow (blue → sky → yellow, half off-screen, drifting) is the only gradient allowed. Never behind small text.
- Type: IBM Plex Sans 700 for headlines, Plex Mono for numbers, code and labels, Plex Serif only for a quote. Arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic; RTL mirrors the layout.
- Say one thing per shot, in as few words as it takes. Numbers are big; their labels are small.
- Motion is quick and exact: things land where they belong and stop. No bounce on text.
- Never: a red or green accent beside the blue; more than one accent colour in a shot; neon, lens flares, particle bursts.
